images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, one decisive action: an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat is the disaster-film first responder in a bioluminescent ocean cave, clinging dramatically to the wall of a bioluminescent trench observation dome during Clockwork time reversal. With a wink-like one-eye squint, the cat pushes a sealed medicine pouch through a portal no larger than one white paw beside a cracked glowing rescue beacon. Falling giant books visibly reverse upward; the pursued hero was carrying emergency medicine, and the package reaches a calm patient inside the dome. The museum world split, glowing trench, beacon, expression, gesture, and tiny portal create clear impact cues. Safe invisible wall grip, padded stage, harmless VFX, accurate paws and reflections. No logos, no readable text, no watermark, no famous artwork, no franchise design, no exact emblem, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no plastic fur, no duplicate cats or limbs, no human features.
Required assigned visual details: the portal is no larger than one white paw; dramatic wall cling.
